parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075102. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
